title: Hope you like rocks, cause we’ve got heaps of f*cking rocks
comments:
Went for a trundle up hermit today to see how the alpine is shaping up. Snow line is sitting around 1650m. You can still basically hike up to the campground. I ditched the trail runners after 2.5km of hiking and managed to break some kind of a trail on skins from just below 1800m. Freezing level came up disgustingly high over the weekend, precip was still falling as rain at 2000m in the afternoon. Just under 50cm of snow sitting on the tent pads at Hermit Campground but streams are still running above 2000m. Snow quality a little nicer as you get higher above the campground. Averaging 80cm of coverage at the toe of Roger’s Glacier (2350m south-east aspect) 10 of which fell last night. 

Temp at valley bottom(1300m): 4 degrees
Temp at campground (2100m): 0 degrees 
Temp at glacier (2350m): -2 degrees 

Summary: Keep biking.
